questions.question: What is the expected major product when 1-Hexene is treated with 1. Hg(OAc)2, H2O; 2. NaBH4?

options.label: A
options.text: 2-Bromo-1-methylcyclohexanol (OH at C1, Br at C2, trans)

questions.explanation: Treating 1-Hexene with 1. Hg(OAc)2, H2O; 2. NaBH4 yields 2-Hexanol (Markovnikov alcohol). Rationale: Oxymercuration forms a cyclic mercurinium ion, avoiding carbocation rearrangements and giving 2° alcohol.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 1-Methylcyclopentene into trans-2-Methylcyclopentanol?
questions.explanation: To convert 1-Methylcyclopentene into trans-2-Methylcyclopentanol, the appropriate reagent is 1. BH3•THF; 2. H2O2, NaOH. Rationale: Concerted syn-addition of B-H places boron at the less hindered C2, which is oxidized with retention of configuration.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when 1-Methylcyclohexene is treated with Br2 / H2O?

options.label: A
options.text: 2-Bromo-1-methylcyclohexanol (OH at C1, Br at C2, trans)

questions.correct_answer: 2-Bromo-1-methylcyclohexanol (OH at C1, Br at C2, trans)
questions.explanation: Treating 1-Methylcyclohexene with Br2 / H2O yields 2-Bromo-1-methylcyclohexanol (OH at C1, Br at C2, trans). Rationale: Water attacks the more substituted C1 of the bromonium ion where partial positive charge is greatest.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 1,2-Dimethylcyclohexene into cis-1,2-Dimethylcyclohexane?
questions.explanation: To convert 1,2-Dimethylcyclohexene into cis-1,2-Dimethylcyclohexane, the appropriate reagent is H2 / Pd-C. Rationale: Both hydrogens add to the same face of the double bond from the metal catalyst surface.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Cyclohexene is treated with mCPBA in CH2Cl2?
questions.explanation: Treating Cyclohexene with mCPBA in CH2Cl2 yields 1,2-Epoxycyclohexane (cyclohexene oxide). Rationale: Peroxy acid delivers an electrophilic oxygen atom to the alkene in a concerted syn-addition.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 1,2-Epoxycyclohexane into trans-1,2-Cyclohexanediol?
questions.explanation: To convert 1,2-Epoxycyclohexane into trans-1,2-Cyclohexanediol, the appropriate reagent is Aqueous H3O+. Rationale: Acid protonates the epoxide; water attacks from the opposite face via SN2 inversion.

questions.question: Which starting material will react with 1. OsO4; 2. NaHSO3, H2O to yield cis-1,2-Cyclopentanediol as the major product?
questions.explanation: Cyclopentene reacts with 1. OsO4; 2. NaHSO3, H2O to yield cis-1,2-Cyclopentanediol. Rationale: Osmium tetroxide forms a cyclic osmate ester intermediate on one face, yielding the syn-diol.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when 2-Methyl-2-pentene is treated with 1. O3; 2. Zn, H2O (or (CH3)2S)?

options.label: A
options.text: 2-Bromo-1-methylcyclohexanol (OH at C1, Br at C2, trans)

questions.explanation: Treating 2-Methyl-2-pentene with 1. O3; 2. Zn, H2O (or (CH3)2S) yields Acetone + Propanal. Rationale: Reductive cleavage of the double bond preserves aldehyde and ketone oxidation states.

questions.question: Which starting material will react with 1. O3; 2. H2O2 to yield Acetone + Propanoic acid as the major product?
questions.explanation: 2-Methyl-2-pentene reacts with 1. O3; 2. H2O2 to yield Acetone + Propanoic acid. Rationale: Oxidative workup oxidizes the aldehyde fragment to a carboxylic acid while keeping ketone intact.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Cyclohexene is treated with CH2I2 + Zn(Cu) in ether?
questions.explanation: Treating Cyclohexene with CH2I2 + Zn(Cu) in ether yields Bicyclo[4.1.0]heptane (norcarane). Rationale: The carbenoid ICH2ZnI transfers a methylene group to the double bond with stereospecific retention.
